# tsundoker.github.io
Reading Challenge to read books from all states of India

<<! <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>India Reading Challenge</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#faf7f2;--card:#fff;--ink:#2a2622;--mute:#7a7068;--line:#e3dccf;--empty:#e9e2d4;--read:#2f7d5b;--accent:#c8501e;color-scheme:light;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#1b1815;--card:#26221e;--ink:#f1ebe2;--mute:#a39a8e;--line:#3a342d;--empty:#3a342d;--read:#3f9b74;--accent:#ff8a57;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#1b1815;--card:#26221e;--ink:#f1ebe2;--mute:#a39a8e;--line:#3a342d;--empty:#3a342d;--read:#3f9b74;--accent:#ff8a57;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;line-height:1.4}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 14px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.6rem;margin:0 0 4px}
.sub{color:var(--mute);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;margin:0 0 12px}
.bar{height:10px;background:var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--read);transition:width .3s}
.count{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
@media(min-width:760px){.wrap{grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;align-items:start}}
svg{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:80vh;display:block}
.st{fill:var(--empty);stroke:var(--bg);stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linejoin:round;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .15s}
.st.read{fill:var(--read)}
.st:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.st.sel{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:4}
.mk{fill:var(--empty);stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:2;cursor:pointer}
.mk.read{fill:var(--read)}
.mk.sel{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:4}
.panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
.panel h2{font-size:1.15rem;margin:0 0 10px;font-family:Georgia,serif}
.hint{color:var(--mute);font-size:.92rem}
.book{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;margin:4px 0}
.by{color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:6px}
label{display:block;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--mute);margin:8px 0 3px}
input{width:100%;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-size:1rem}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
button.b{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-size:.95rem;cursor:pointer}
button.b.p{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.05rem;margin:22px 0 6px}
ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.92rem}
li{padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}
li span{color:var(--mute)}
.note{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--mute);margin-top:10px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
<h1>India Reading Challenge</h1>
<p class="sub">One book from every state, plus five union territories. Tap a state on the map.</p>
<div class="bar"><i id="bar"></i></div>
<div class="count" id="count"></div>
<div class="wrap">
<svg id="map" viewBox="0 0 1629 1819" role="img" aria-label="Map of India"></svg>
<div class="panel" id="panel"></div>
</div>
<h3>Books read</h3>
<ul id="list"></ul>
<h3>Leaderboard</h3>
<p class="note">Everyone taking part can see each other’s names, counts and books. Tap a name to see their books.</p>

<p class="note" id="note">Small states and territories are shown as circles on the map. Map boundaries are simplified.</p>
</main>

var NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
var NAMES=Object.keys(MAP.s).sort();
var entries={},sel=null,editing=false,ref=null,KEY="india-reading-v1";
var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i)};
function pretty(n){return n.replace(/ and /g," & ")}
function persist(){
  try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(entries))}catch(e){}
  if(ref){ref.set({entries:entries,count:Object.keys(entries).length}).catch(function(){$("note").textContent="Couldn’t sync to your account; saved on this device only."})}
}
function build(){
  var svg=$("map");
  NAMES.forEach(function(n){
    var s=MAP.s[n],p=document.createElementNS(NS,"path");
    p.setAttribute("d",s.d);p.setAttribute("class","st");p.setAttribute("fill-rule","evenodd");p.dataset.n=n;
    var t=document.createElementNS(NS,"title");t.textContent=pretty(n);p.appendChild(t);
    p.onclick=function(){pick(n)};svg.appendChild(p);
  });
  NAMES.forEach(function(n){
    var s=MAP.s[n];if(s.a>=0.35)return;
    var c=document.createElementNS(NS,"circle");
    c.setAttribute("cx",s.c[0]);c.setAttribute("cy",s.c[1]);c.setAttribute("r",11);c.setAttribute("class","mk");c.dataset.n=n;
    var t=document.createElementNS(NS,"title");t.textContent=pretty(n);c.appendChild(t);
    c.onclick=function(){pick(n)};svg.appendChild(c);
  });
}
function render(){
  var n=0;
  document.querySelectorAll("#map [data-n]").forEach(function(el){
    var k=el.dataset.n,base=el.tagName==="circle"?"mk":"st";
    el.setAttribute("class",base+(entries[k]?" read":"")+(sel===k?" sel":""));
  });
  NAMES.forEach(function(k){if(entries[k])n++});
  $("bar").style.width=(n/NAMES.length*100)+"%";
  $("count").textContent=n+" of "+NAMES.length+" states and territories read";
  var ul=$("list");ul.innerHTML="";
  var done=NAMES.filter(function(k){return entries[k]});
  if(!done.length){var li=document.createElement("li");li.textContent="Nothing yet. Pick a state to begin.";ul.appendChild(li)}
  done.forEach(function(k){
    var e=entries[k],li=document.createElement("li"),b=document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent=e.title;li.appendChild(b);
    var sp=document.createElement("span");sp.textContent=(e.author?" by "+e.author:"")+" · "+pretty(k);li.appendChild(sp);
    li.onclick=function(){pick(k)};ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  panel();
}
function el(tag,txt,cls){var e=document.createElement(tag);if(txt!=null)e.textContent=txt;if(cls)e.className=cls;return e}
function btn(txt,cls,fn){var b=el("button",txt,"b "+(cls||""));b.onclick=fn;return b}
function panel(){
  var p=$("panel");p.innerHTML="";
  if(!sel){p.appendChild(el("p","Select a state or union territory to see its book or add one.","hint"));return}
  p.appendChild(el("h2",pretty(sel)));
  var e=entries[sel];
  if(e&&!editing){
    p.appendChild(el("div",e.title,"book"));
    if(e.author)p.appendChild(el("div","by "+e.author,"by"));
    var r=el("div",null,"row");
    r.appendChild(btn("Edit","",function(){editing=true;panel()}));
    r.appendChild(btn("Remove","",function(){delete entries[sel];persist();render()}));
    p.appendChild(r);return;
  }
  p.appendChild(el("div",e?"Edit book":"No book added yet. Add one:","hint"));
  var l1=el("label","Book title");l1.htmlFor="title";p.appendChild(l1);
  var t=el("input");t.id="title";t.autocomplete="off";t.value=e?e.title:"";p.appendChild(t);
  var l2=el("label","Author (optional)");l2.htmlFor="author";p.appendChild(l2);
  var a=el("input");a.id="author";a.autocomplete="off";a.value=e?e.author||"":"";p.appendChild(a);
  var r=el("div",null,"row");
  r.appendChild(btn(e?"Save":"Add book","p",function(){
    var v=t.value.trim();if(!v)return;
    entries[sel]={title:v,author:a.value.trim()};editing=false;persist();render();
  }));
  if(e)r.appendChild(btn("Cancel","",function(){editing=false;panel()}));
  p.appendChild(r);
}
function pick(n){sel=n;editing=false;render()}
try{var raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(raw)entries=JSON.parse(raw)||{}}catch(e){}
build();render();
var ME=null,ROWS=[],OPEN={};
async function drawBoard(user){
  var b=$("board");
  var rows=ROWS.slice().sort(function(a,c){return c.count-a.count});
  var names={};
  try{names=await user.profiles(rows.map(function(r){return r.id}))}catch(e){}
  b.innerHTML="";
  if(!rows.length){b.appendChild(el("p","No one has joined yet.","hint"));return}
  rows.forEach(function(r,i){
    var d=document.createElement("details");
    d.style.cssText="border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 0;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif";
    d.open=!!OPEN[r.id];d.ontoggle=function(){OPEN[r.id]=d.open};
    var s=document.createElement("summary");s.style.cursor="pointer";
    var nm=(names[r.id]&&names[r.id].name)||"Someone";
    s.textContent=(i+1)+". "+nm+(r.id===ME?" (you)":"")+" — "+r.count+" of "+NAMES.length;
    d.appendChild(s);
    var ul=document.createElement("ul");
    Object.keys(r.entries).sort().forEach(function(k){
      var e=r.entries[k],li=document.createElement("li");li.style.cursor="default";
      var bb=document.createElement("b");bb.textContent=e.title;li.appendChild(bb);
      var sp=document.createElement("span");sp.textContent=(e.author?" by "+e.author:"")+" · "+pretty(k);li.appendChild(sp);
      ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    if(!r.count){var li=document.createElement("li");li.textContent="No books yet.";li.style.cursor="default";ul.appendChild(li)}
    d.appendChild(ul);b.appendChild(d);
  });
}
function watchBoard(db,user){
  var fail=function(){$("board").textContent="Leaderboard unavailable right now."};
  var t=setTimeout(fail,10000);
  db.collection("readers").onSnapshot(function(q){
    clearTimeout(t);
    ROWS=q.docs.map(function(x){
      var d=x.data()||{},en={},raw=(d.entries&&typeof d.entries==="object")?d.entries:{};
      Object.keys(raw).forEach(function(k){var e=raw[k];if(MAP.s[k]&&e&&typeof e.title==="string")en[k]={title:e.title,author:typeof e.author==="string"?e.author:""}});
      return {id:x.id,entries:en,count:Object.keys(en).length};
    });
    drawBoard(user);
  },function(){clearTimeout(t);fail()});
}
(async function(){
  try{
    var user=await claude.use("user"),db=await claude.use("db");
    var nt=$("note");
    if(!user||!db){nt.textContent="Not signed in to claude.ai: your books are saved on this device only.";return}
    var id=await user.id();if(!id){nt.textContent="Not signed in to claude.ai: your books are saved on this device only.";return}
    ME=id;
    var r=db.doc("readers/"+id),snap=await r.get();
    var d=snap.exists?snap.data():null;
    if(!d){
      try{var old=await db.doc("data/users/"+id+"/reading").get();var od=old.exists?old.data():null;if(od&&od.entries)d={entries:od.entries}}catch(e){}
    }
    if(d&&d.entries)entries=d.entries;
    ref=r;nt.textContent="Signed in: your books sync across your devices and appear on the leaderboard.";
    if(!snap.exists)persist();
    render();
    watchBoard(db,user);
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
